audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is labelled Aatrox in both layers (content win[0], full phases[0].side) while every prose field says Camille clearly owns it.
audit.why: Aatrox has one Q swing, no Infernal Chains and no ramped Umbral Dash healing at level 1; Camille's empowered Precision Protocol plus Adaptive Defenses wins that exchange.
audit.corrected: Level 1 should read Camille; levels 2-5 Aatrox/skill; 6 onward Camille. Side/rating fields are too short to edit inside the length band, so flagged rather than rewritten.

audit.why: Spikes are keyed correctly: Camille at 2 (Hookshot), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum) and Sheen/Trinity; Aatrox at his second Q rank, 6 and drain-tank items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Key Ability Interactions block only repeats 'track World Ender' and never states the two facts that decide the lane: Hookshot needs terrain, and Umbral Dash heals on every hit on a 9s cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's kit text: Umbral Dash 'Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions', cooldown 9/8/7/6/5. Camille's Hookshot 'pulls herself to a wall' — with no wall in reach she has no engage and no stun.
audit.corrected: State the wall requirement and the 9s Umbral Dash refresh so trade length is tied to a real number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Critical Don'ts have titles that do not match their descriptions ('Sit in his Q sweetspots' explains E usage; 'Fight his R without anti-heal' explains the passive shield).
audit.why: Copy-paste from the trading block left the pairs mismatched, so the page gives no actual sweetspot or anti-heal advice.
audit.corrected: Rewritten so each description answers its own title with Riot cooldowns (Q 14s at rank 1, World Ender 120s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: MC_WR_TABLES lists camille vs aatrox at 45.31 while the audit packet reports 51.61 over 808 games.
audit.why: Two different sources disagree; MC_WR_TABLES is not writable and I cannot verify which is the Emerald+ headline row.
audit.corrected: Left untouched, raised for the user.

edits.before: Aatrox has only one Q swing and no heal pressure yet — walk up, land your empowered Q first hit so Adaptive Defense pops on his return swing, and you win the level-1 chip clean.
edits.after: Aatrox has only one Q swing and no heal pressure yet — walk up, land your empowered Q first hit so Adaptive Defenses pops on his return swing, and you win the level-1 chip clean.

edits.before: Win the level-1 exchange with an empowered Q before his Q-plus-Infernal-Chains combo exists, baiting Adaptive Defense onto his weakest swing
edits.after: Win the level-1 exchange with an empowered Q before his Q-plus-Infernal-Chains combo exists, baiting Adaptive Defenses onto his weakest swing

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Aatrox edges this stage.

edits.before: Full early kit with W online. Space the outer blade to heal, weave the empowered second Q for true damage, and keep E held until World Ender is committed. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Full early kit with W online. Space the outer blade to heal, weave the empowered second Q for true damage, and keep E held until World Ender is committed. This is a clean skill phase.

edits.before: Your E is your engage, escape, and reposition — burning it for tiny value leaves you exposed for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Q knocks up only on the sweetspot tip, three swings off one 14s cast — step inside the arc, not the edge.

edits.before: Without your Adaptive Defenses shield up, short trades flip — wait for the passive before you step up.
edits.after: World Ender amps his healing across a 120s cooldown — buy Executioner's before any long trade in it.

edits.before: Track Aatrox's World Ender: His drain ramps in long fights. Keep trades short. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Hookshot needs a wall or you have no engage. His Umbral Dash heals him every hit and is back up every 9s.

notes: Camille kit file flags R as 'channel: interruptible' and 'untargetable' — both look like tooltip-parse misfires (Riot's own text describes a dash plus an anchoring zone, no channel and no untargetability). I did not assert either. Full-layer phases[0].side and content win[0] both say 'Aatrox' for Level 1 while every prose field on both layers says Camille owns it; those fields are 6-7 characters so no edit fits the +/-10% band.
